individual-data-points.explanation: Stacked bar/area chart across continuous Pol II ChIP-seq bins summarizing median promoter-state frequencies for n=5912 promoters; behaves like a line/area plot where overlaying individual promoter values would be unreadable, so individual points are not required.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The stacked bar/area chart shows median state frequencies per bin with no error bars present.

individual-data-points.explanation: Each row of the single-molecule stack plots an individual DNA molecule's methylation pattern, so the underlying individual data points are shown alongside the aggregate state-frequency sidebars and percentages.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The single-molecule stack and frequency sidebars display raw methylation calls and percentages without error bars.

individual-data-points.explanation: Same representation as (A) for mouse promoters (n=6122): a stacked bar/area chart across ChIP-seq bins, for which individual point overlay is impractical and not required.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Same representation as (A): median state frequencies shown without error bars.

individual-data-points.explanation: Same representation as (B) for a mouse promoter: each row is an individual DNA molecule, so individual data points are displayed with the aggregate sidebars.

individual-data-points.explanation: Box plots inherently display the data distribution (median, IQR, outliers), so individual data points are not required.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The middle line of the box represents the median. The box displays the interquartile range (IQR), 25th to 75th percentile. Whiskers represent a distance of 1.5 x IQR.
error-bars-defined.explanation: Box plot median, box (IQR) and whiskers are explicitly defined in the caption.
